agent_summary: P6-P1 review of the dual-artifact SDTMIG 3.4 source baseline and seven proposed Gold Set statements. Approval calibrates extraction tests only; it does not publish production Wiki knowledge.

findings.title: Accept the PDF and XLSX as one versioned dual-artifact source
findings.current_value: User-provided copies are hash-locked, local-only, and restricted; PDF machine visual QA passed 461 of 461 pages.
findings.proposed_value: Use the PDF as primary narrative/page evidence and the XLSX as structured normative metadata for SDTMIG 3.4 extraction calibration.
findings.rationale: The two artifacts carry different evidence granularity and must remain independently hash-bound without duplicating facts.

findings.title: Calibrate Events representation guidance as a should-level requirement
findings.proposed_value: Subject-level study observations should be represented using the applicable SDTM general observation class.
findings.rationale: The PDF paragraph uses should-level language and applies the general observation-class model to the listed Events domains.

findings.title: Calibrate the AE overview as a domain definition
findings.proposed_value: AE represents untoward medical occurrences without requiring a causal relationship to treatment.
findings.rationale: The statement summarizes the AE Description/Overview and does not add an implementation mandate.

findings.title: Calibrate the AE dataset structure from the specification table
findings.proposed_value: The AE dataset structure is one record per adverse event per subject.
findings.rationale: The dataset-level structure is stated in the PDF specification heading and is distinct from variable-level rules.

findings.title: Calibrate AETERM as a must-level variable rule with dual evidence
findings.current_value: proposed variable_rule; modality must; PDF and XLSX evidence
findings.proposed_value: AETERM is the required AE topic variable and must contain the collected verbatim event term.
findings.rationale: The XLSX marks AETERM as Core=Req while PDF assumption 2a supplies the explicit must-have-value semantics.

findings.title: Keep AE Example 1 informative rather than normative
findings.proposed_value: Treat the free-text collection, MedDRA coding, term modification, and seriousness details as one study scenario, not a universal requirement.
findings.rationale: Examples are useful retrieval context but must not be promoted into requirements during LLM extraction.

findings.title: Preserve the AEENRF relative-timing cross-reference
findings.proposed_value: Interpret allowable AEENRF codelist values together with the general relative-timing guidance in Section 4.4.7.
findings.rationale: The XLSX row explicitly points to a general section, so the reference must remain a typed edge rather than copied prose.

findings.title: Apply the published --LNKGRP erratum as qualifying evidence
findings.proposed_value: For RELTYPE=MANY, use --LNKGRP rather than --LNKID for IDVAR as stated by the release-page erratum.
findings.rationale: Errata qualify the frozen PDF without mutating it and must outrank the affected original wording in later retrieval.
